Normfunctie.title: Normfunctie
Normfunctie.description: A read-only reference row from the HR21 (VNG-owned municipal functiewaarderingssysteem) normfunctie library, mapping one standard job function to a Cao Gemeenten schaal. Seeded illustrative subset only (allowCreate:false) -- NOT a claimed-complete ~150-function library; the exact HR21 normfunctie catalog was not independently verified from a primary VNG source (proposal.md 'Honesty about verification'). caoSchaal lives in the same key space cao-gemeenten.payScales uses, but this schema does not itself invent or store any schaal figures -- it only records which schaal a normfunctie maps to. An EmploymentContract links to a Normfunctie via normfunctieId, HR-set, never derived.

functiecode.title: Functiecode
functiecode.description: The stable HR21 normfunctie code (e.g. 'HR21-001'). The natural key a maintainer identifies this normfunctie by.

functiegroep.title: Functiegroep
functiegroep.description: The HR21 hoofdproces this normfunctie belongs to (e.g. 'Beleid', 'Beheer', 'Management').

caoSchaal.title: CAO schaal
caoSchaal.description: The Cao Gemeenten schaal (numeric key '1'-'19', the same key space cao-gemeenten.payScales uses) this normfunctie maps to. Read against EmploymentContract.caoSchaal by nl-hr21-schaal-consistentie only when caoSchaalVerified is true.

caoSchaalVerified.title: CAO schaal verified
caoSchaalVerified.description: Whether this normfunctie's caoSchaal mapping is confirmed against a primary HR21/VNG source. When false the mapping is advisory (placeholder) and nl-hr21-schaal-consistentie stays vacuous for any contract assigned to it -- the cao-library payScalesVerified precedent, applied to a classification mapping instead of a rate.

caoSchaalSource.title: CAO schaal source
caoSchaalSource.description: Human-readable note naming the authority to confirm this mapping against (e.g. 'HR21/VNG functieboek -- not yet independently confirmed'), or explaining why a specific row was flipped to verified for illustrative/demonstration purposes only.
